verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs confirm webhook events fire on configured triggers (e.g., subscription_cancelled) and community evidence corroborates real-world usage with multiple webhook URLs across environments, showing a mature, working event-subscription mechanism suitable for agentic/automated consumption. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of webhook payload schema/retry semantics or AI-specific event filtering, and no independent hands-on verification of webhook reliability at scale.
